exercises.name: Quick squeeze
exercises.description: Squeeze hard for 1 second, release at once

exercises.name: Standing and walking holds
exercises.description: Slow holds while upright, then while walking

exercises.name: Bridge with hold
exercises.description: Squeeze, lift hips, hold, lower and release

exercises.name: Squat with coordination
exercises.description: Relax going down, squeeze coming up

exercises.name: The Knack
exercises.description: Squeeze just before a cough, lift or sneeze

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic breathing
exercises.description: Belly breath in as the pelvic floor lets go

exercises.name: Reverse Kegel
exercises.description: Gently release and lengthen instead of squeezing
